item.title: Morning Weather for Monday, September 07
item.description: Good morning! Welcome to your weather report for Monday, September 7. It's Monday, the start of a brand new week. Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be damp with light drizzle. The warmest part of the day will be 30 degrees, and the coolest 23. Rain is about 35 percent likely today. It's going to be hot. Drink lots of water and wear a hat! Watch out for snails after the rain. They love wet weather! As for tomorrow, expect it to be a little bit rainy, with a high of 30 degrees. Something to think about: what would you put in a treasure box? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
